summary: PersonalEA is a microservices-based AI assistant system for goal setting and strategy planning

keyFindings.appType: AI-powered personal executive assistant with goal strategy management
keyFindings.primaryService: Goal Strategy Service on port 8085 using OpenAI API
keyFindings.testingFramework: Comprehensive with Playwright E2E and Jest unit tests
keyFindings.realApiSupport: Full support for testing with real OpenAI API keys

services.name: Goal Strategy Service
services.command: cd services/goal-strategy && npm install && npm run dev

services.name: Frontend
services.command: cd testing/goal-strategy-test && npm install && npm run dev

avoidFallbacks: Use real OpenAI API key in environment
Run openai-api-server.js as proxy to real API
Avoid mock-api-server.js which has static responses
